At its annual I/O developer conference, Google announced a sweeping redesign of the search box itself â the literal text field where billions of queries begin every day â transforming it from a simple keyword input into a dynamic, AI-driven conversation starter that can accept text, images, PDFs, videos, and even open Chrome tabs as inputs.
